propositions: Current clarity_score rewards volume and legacy shape rather than author-guide leaf/container contract, allowing padded tickets to pass without required sections.
Clarity measure implementation is duplicated across _engine_support/gates.py and llm/plan_review/det_floor.py, creating drift risk and maintenance burden.
Deterministic checks for required section content, AC checkbox verification coverage, placeholder-free language, and structured file impact can be mechanically tested without semantic judgment.
Author guide and plan-review criteria documentation conflict on Success Criteria headers and rejected-alternative requirements, creating ambiguity in what clarity should enforce.
Testing section shape requirements cannot be deterministically inferred because applicability depends on whether behavior is testable, and must remain advisory or LLM-reviewed.
